privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: Ahoshinet Groups (Administrator: darui3018823, the "Operator") establishes this Privacy Policy regarding the handling of personal information in "Subscription Manager App" (the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
privacy.s2_body:
The Service collects the following information:

· Username (upon account registration; an email address is not collected as registration data)
· Subscription information (name, amount, billing cycle, and other user-entered data)
· Payment method information (card brand, last 4 digits, custom name, etc.)
· Account time zone (initialized from the device and editable in Settings)
· Google account email address (only when the Google integration feature is used)
· Parsed results from Paidy billing emails (only when the Google integration feature is used)

We do not collect other device identifiers, location information, or behavioral logs.
privacy.s3_body:
Collected information is used solely for the following purposes:

· Providing and maintaining the Service
· Improving the Service and developing new features
· Identity verification and account management
· Responding to inquiries
privacy.s4_body:
The Operator will not provide, disclose, or sell collected personal information to third parties, except in the following cases:

· When the user has given explicit consent
· When disclosure is required by law or regulation
privacy.s5_body:
The Service does not currently use third-party analytics or tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Firebase, or Sentry. The Service is available on Android, iOS, and Web. The Web version stores its authentication token in browser session storage, but does not use tracking cookies or local storage for authentication.

When the Google integration feature is used, the Service communicates with Google's servers via the Gmail API. See Article 12 for details.
privacy.s6_body: Collected information is stored on servers managed and operated directly by the Operator. No data is transferred to or processed by external cloud services. The Operator implements appropriate security measures to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or alteration of data.
privacy.s7_body: Collected information is retained until the user's account is deleted. Upon account deletion, personal information will be promptly erased or anonymized.
privacy.s8_body: Users have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of their personal information. Data that can be managed within the app may be deleted by the user directly. For account deletion or data that cannot be removed from within the app, please contact us via the contact page.
privacy.s9_body: The Operator may update this Privacy Policy at any time as deemed necessary. Changes will take effect upon notification within the Service or upon posting on the Service. Continued use of the Service after any change constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.
privacy.s10_body: This Privacy Policy shall be governed by the laws of Japan. Any disputes relating to this Policy shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Tokyo District Court as the court of first instance.
privacy.s11_body:
For inquiries regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

https://corp.daruks.com/contact
privacy.s12_title: Article 12 (Google Account Integration and Gmail Data Usage)
privacy.s12_body:
The Service provides an optional Google integration feature (Gmail integration). When this feature is used, the following applies:

[Data Accessed]
Using Gmail read-only permission (gmail.readonly), the Service accesses only emails from Paidy LLC (@paidy.com) with the subject "ご利用確定のお知らせ" (transaction confirmation), and parses transaction amounts, dates, and merchant names on-device. Raw email content is never transmitted to or stored on the Operator's servers.

[Access Token Storage]
The Google access token is stored only in the device's secure storage (SecureStore). It is never sent to the Operator's servers.

[Server-Side Data]
Only the parsed summary (total amount, billing month, transaction list) is stored on the Operator's servers.

[Purpose of Use]
This data is used solely to automatically display Paidy billing amounts in the subscription list. It is never shared with third parties or used for advertising.

[Revoking Access]
You can disconnect Google integration at any time from the Settings screen. Upon disconnection, the access token and all parsed data on the server will be deleted.

This feature uses the API provided by Google LLC (USA). For Google's Privacy Policy, please visit https://policies.google.com/privacy

tos.title: Terms of Service

tos.s2_body: The Service is available to users of all ages, except where restricted by the laws of the user's country of residence. Minors must obtain consent from a parent or legal guardian before using the Service.
tos.s3_body: The Service is an application that helps users manage their subscription information in one place. The Service is currently provided free of charge. The Operator may modify or discontinue the Service with prior notice.
tos.s4_body: An account registration is required to use the Service. Users are responsible for keeping their registration information accurate and up to date. Users are solely responsible for managing their account credentials and must not transfer or lend them to any third party. Accounts may be suspended or deleted if false information is registered.
tos.s5_body:
Users must not engage in any of the following activities:

· Unauthorized access to, reverse engineering of, or equivalent analysis of the Service's servers or other non-public systems
· Use of accounts, APIs, or other hosted services provided by the Operator for commercial purposes without authorization
· Harassment or nuisance behavior toward other users
· Activities that violate laws, regulations, or public order and morals
· Denial-of-service (DoS) attacks or other actions that place excessive load on the Service's servers
· Any other activities deemed inappropriate by the Operator

Use, modification, and redistribution of publicly available client software are governed by the applicable open-source license accompanying that software.
tos.s6_body: Data entered by users, such as subscription information, is stored securely on servers managed by the Operator. Collected information is used solely to provide and improve the Service, and personal information will not be sold or provided to third parties. For details, please refer to the separate Privacy Policy.
tos.s7_body: The Operator may suspend or delete an account without prior notice if a user violates these Terms or if the Operator determines there is other legitimate cause. Users who wish to delete their account may contact the Operator through the contact page.
tos.s8_body: The Operator makes no representations or warranties, express or implied, regarding the Service. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Operator shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of or inability to use the Service, except in cases of intentional misconduct or gross negligence. Users are responsible for verifying the accuracy of their subscription information.
tos.s9_body: The Operator may update these Terms at any time as deemed necessary. Updated Terms will take effect upon notification within the Service or upon posting on the Service. Continued use of the Service after any change constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
tos.s10_body: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Japan. Any disputes relating to the Service shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Tokyo District Court as the court of first instance.
tos.s11_body:
